fields.System.Title: OUT-106 — Amend an order line before allocation
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a customer service agent, I want to change a quantity before stock is committed, so
that a customer correction does not require cancelling and recreating the order.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given an unallocated line, then its quantity can be changed or the line removed.
  • - Given an allocated line, then amendment is rejected until it is deallocated via
  • [OUT-206](OUT-206-deallocate-order-line.md).
  • - Given a picked line, then amendment is rejected outright.
  • - Given an amendment, then the previous values are retained in the audit trail.
  • - Given a line reduced to zero, then it is closed rather than left as a zero-quantity
  • line.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | outbound |
| Tables | order_line, audit_log |
| Risks | Amending an allocated line leaves reservations pointing at nothing ([doc 09 §5.5](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration |
